why:
Three of the four must_catch items are handled. Item 1 is met: the builder brief says "Run `npm install` at the root so package-lock.json picks up the new workspace and commit the lock change". Item 2 is met: it says "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet". Item 4 is met: verifier check 6 confirms the Closes line in the PR body and that the test workflow is green at the PR head SHA, using `gh pr checks` or the checks API.

Item 3 fails. The verifier brief does run `npm ci && npm test` from the root, but it never checks that the jsonl-lint tests actually run there, even though the root script uses --if-present. It doesn't ask for a test count. Its mutation step says "mutate lint() mentally or briefly ... confirm a test would fail". A mental mutation proves nothing about whether the tests run, and the brief never ties a real failure to the root npm test. So a skipped workspace would not be caught.
